tldr: Sun in the 2nd house: identity becomes personal through money, values, security, self-worth, and what helps life feel steady.
body:
With the Sun in the 2nd house, this part of you develops through money, values, security, self-worth, and what helps life feel steady. The Sun describes identity, vitality, confidence, visibility, and the need to live from a clear center. In practice, this brings attention to what you earn, keep, choose, spend, protect, and come to understand as worth your energy.

When this placement is supported, you can build a steadier relationship with what supports you. The Sun can become presence, confidence, creative authority, and a stronger sense of purpose.

When it is strained, comfort, spending, fear, or self-protection can start making choices for you. The harder pattern can show up as over-identifying with the outcome or confusing attention with self-worth.
gift: presence, confidence, creative authority, and a stronger sense of purpose expressed through money, values, security, self-worth, and what helps life feel steady.
challenge: over-identifying with the outcome or confusing attention with self-worth around money, values, security, self-worth, and what helps life feel steady.
